passages.note: This page prints the operative expansion he voted against but names no voter and no tally.
The sponsor list and governor action name other members, not Mathis, so this page records no act of his.

rows.reasoning: Mathis voted No on HB2853 (2022), whose added section makes a "qualified student" any resident eligible to enroll in a public school in a kindergarten program or any of grades one through twelve. A No on an expansion bill establishes only that he is against expanding vouchers; it does not separate "Eliminating voucher programs that divert taxpayer money from public schools to private institutions" from "Opposing voucher programs and blocking their expansion, without moving to eliminate existing ones".
needs_source: Mathis's own act or own words on repealing the existing Arizona empowerment scholarship account program (a repeal bill, a vote on a repeal amendment, or a first-person call for repeal), to separate the eliminate rung from the oppose-expansion rung
